name: My Airport 2
desc:
👋 Welcome to My Airport 2, where you take control of the skies!

✈️ Build and customize your very own airport the way you want it!
🛫 Manage flights, transport passengers, and earn cash along the way!
😎 Live your dream of building and managing a bustling airport.

⚠️ This game is currently in BETA, so expect bugs and exciting new features coming soon!

Airplane, Airport, Build, Simulator, Airline, Travel, Adventur, AirTraffic OpenWorld, Multiplayer,Tycoon
